findings.description: The two new optional-elaboration placeholders in the Merge Danger template are asymmetric in specificity: `<optional: potential ramifications of merge>` under Blast Radius tells the agent exactly what content goes there, while `<optional: description>` under Door is generic and doesn't say a description of what (rationale for the door choice vs. something else, left to inference from position). Since this file is a fill-in-the-blank template for an agent, the Door placeholder would benefit from the same specificity as its sibling, e.g. `<optional: why it's one-way or two-way>`.
